about.about2:
At Royz Store, we believe that everything you need... should be just a click away.

We are a comprehensive online store that combines product quality, variety, and accessibility to provide you with an all-in-one shopping experience. Whether you're looking for a daily grocery item, a stylish piece of clothing, or even real estate for your future – we're here to offer you all that and more.

What do we offer?
 • Fresh and packaged food items to suit all tastes and budgets.
 • High-quality clothing and shoes with modern designs for the whole family.
 • Real estate through our specialized section, connecting you to the best residential and commercial opportunities.
 • Fast and secure delivery service to your doorstep, because your comfort is our priority.

Our Mission:

We build a digital shopping platform you trust and always turn to. We aspire to be the first choice for those seeking quality, transparency, and ease.

Why Us?
 • Unique variety under one digital roof.
 • Always-available customer service.
 • Trusted partnerships.
 • Simple interface and seamless experience.
 • Fast delivery within your city.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: This is the Privacy Policy page. Add your privacy policy details here.
privacy.privacy2:
Introduction:

At Royz Store, we are committed to protecting the privacy of your personal data. This policy aims to inform you about how we collect, use, and protect the data you provide to us while using our online store. We value your trust and promise that your data will remain secure according to the highest protection standards.

Data Collection:

We collect personal data that you provide to us when registering your account, making a purchase, or contacting us through the website. The data we collect includes, but is not limited to:

Full name

Email address

Phone number

Mailing address

Payment data (such as credit card or bank account)

How Data is Collected:

Data is collected through electronic forms during registration, completing a purchase, or through interactions with the store via email or phone.

We also collect non-personal data such as device type, IP address, and user traffic on the site using technologies like cookies to improve your experience.

Data Usage:

We use your personal data for the following purposes:

Processing orders, payments, and shipping.

Improving our services and user experience.

Sending marketing messages about clothing, shoes, and real estate that may interest you (if you have agreed to this).

Responding to your inquiries or providing customer support.

Complying with any legal or regulatory requirements.

Additional Uses:

Your data may be used to personalize your store experience, such as providing personalized recommendations.

Making improvements to the site based on user behavior and data analytics.

Data Protection:

We take all technical and organizational measures to ensure your personal data is protected from unauthorized access or tampering. We use encryption technologies and advanced security solutions to secure sensitive data such as payment information.

Sharing Data with Third Parties:

We do not share your personal data with any third parties except in the following cases:

If necessary to fulfill orders, such as shipping companies or payment service providers.

If the law requires us to disclose data.

To meet our operational needs under professional terms (such as IT service providers).

Service Partner Details:

We may cooperate with trusted shipping companies or payment service providers in Syria and abroad to process transactions.

Data Sharing in Emergencies:

Data may be shared in the event of legal threats or in cases of fraud or security attempts.

User Data Rights:

You have the right to access, modify, or delete your personal data. You can contact us via [email or other means] to exercise these rights.

Additional Details on Rights:

You have the right to request a copy of your personal data that we hold.

You may object to the use of your data for marketing purposes, and you can opt out of receiving marketing messages.

Data Retention Period:

We retain personal data only as long as necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected, after which the data is securely deleted.

Cookies:

We use cookies to improve the user experience, such as personalizing content and displaying relevant offers. You can manage cookie settings through your browser settings.

Privacy Policy Updates:

We reserve the right to modify or update this privacy policy at any time. You will be notified of any changes via the website or by email. It is recommended to review this policy regularly for updates.

How Users Will Be Notified:

We will notify users of any changes by posting updates on this page or via email notifications.

Governing Law:

This privacy policy is subject to Syrian laws regarding personal data protection. In case of any dispute, jurisdiction will be in Syria.

Direct Contact:

If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights regarding your personal data, you can contact us via:

Email: [email]

Phone: [phone number]

vendorDeitels.title: Why Royz?
vendorDeitels.description: Royz Store is the ideal solution for shop owners, investors, wholesalers, factories, commercial centers, service providers, and freelancers. We provide a comprehensive platform that enables you to manage products and sales operations easily and efficiently, and expand your business effectively through e-marketing with your brand. No programming experience needed, we provide you with a simple, fast interface and advanced tools for managing orders, inventory, and shipping operations efficiently.

items.title: Factories
